chunks: From him, from Muḥammad ibn Sahl, from his father, from Isḥāq ibn ʿAbd Allāh, from Abū al-Ḥasan عليه السلام, who said:
If the mutamattiʿ arrives on the night of ʿArafah, then he no longer has mutʿah; rather, he makes it into an individual hajj. Mutʿah is only up to the Day of Tarwiyah.

key_terms.حَجَّةً مُفْرَدَةً: an individual hajj performed separately rather than as tamattuʿ
key_terms.لَيْلَةَ عَرَفَةَ: the night preceding or associated with the standing at ʿArafah
key_terms.مُتْعَةٌ: here, the rite of hajj al-tamattuʿ
key_terms.يَوْمِ التَّرْوِيَةِ: the 8th of Dhū al-Ḥijjah, marking the latest point mentioned here for mutʿah

ai.seo_question: Until what time can a pilgrim still perform hajj al-tamattuʿ according to this hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a fiqh ruling about the time limit for hajj al-tamattuʿ. It states that if a pilgrim arrives only on the night of ʿArafah, the opportunity for mutʿah has passed, and the pilgrimage is treated as an individual hajj, with the valid period for mutʿah extending only until the Day of Tarwiyah.
